name: Park Lighting
justification: Wordy pandemic framing, but one observation (each lantern lights at most 2 cells and a perfect near-tiling exists) makes it a one-liner.
solution_sketch: Each lantern lights at most two cells, so at least ceil(n*m/2) are needed. Dominoes tile the grid leaving at most one cell, so ceil(n*m/2) is achievable. Answer = (n*m+1)//2.
